title: Weather Risk and Worker Mobility
description_1:
This paper studies how local weather shocks affect job transitions and geographic mobility [@smith2020].

Using the framework of @jones2018, I combine administrative employment records with high-frequency weather data in an event-study design.
description_2: The results show that workers in affected areas are more likely to change jobs [@smith2020; @jones2018], with larger effects for low-income households.
